customManagers.description: Makefile defaults mirror the digest-pinned Dockerfile base images; make verify-pins fails if the two drift, so both are updated in the same PR (see the base image groups below).
Checksum-verified tool/runtime versions annotated with a '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' comment on the line above (Dockerfile ARGs and their Makefile mirrors).

syft, which generates the release SBOMs: version and release-tarball sha256 pinned together in scripts/install-syft.sh. The github-release-attachments datasource reads the new sha256 from the release's checksums file, so both lines change in one PR.

packageRules.description: Supply-chain inputs (actions, container images, bundled binaries) are always human-reviewed; label them for triage.
Org practice: automerge patch-level Go module updates once every check passes. platformAutomerge=false makes Renovate itself wait for all checks, independent of repo auto-merge settings.
Let new module, action and tool releases age before proposing them, so a compromised or yanked release is usually caught upstream first. Docker registries without timestamps are excluded.
Actions are pinned to full-semver tags, so a digest-only change means the tag was moved (the tj-actions pattern). Never a routine PR: require explicit approval on the dependency dashboard.
Kairos release tags are immutable; a digest-only update means the tag was re-pushed (kairos#4203). Require explicit approval.
prBodyNotes: Digest-only update of an immutable release tag: confirm the re-push with the Kairos maintainers before approving.

packageRules.description: Go toolchain: the go.mod go directive and the provider builder image (golang:*-alpine) must move together; make verify-pins fails on drift.

STATIC_BUILDER_IMAGE (plain golang tag) compiles upstream kubelet and containerd and tracks the Go minor upstream Kubernetes builds with: take patches only, move minors by hand (the kubelet-build stage fails if upstream's .go-version is newer). separateMinorPatch is REQUIRED for that to work: without it Renovate collapses the golang image to its newest version only, which is a newer MINOR that this rule disables, so the 1.26.x patch stream is never offered at all. That is how Go 1.26.11 arrived as a red image build on every PR instead of as a routine patch PR -- upstream moved .go-version to 1.26.11 on release-1.35, -1.36 and -1.37 while this stayed on 1.26.10.

Hadron and kairos-init are a matched pair, not two independent pins: the final stage re-runs kairos-init against the Hadron base, and a kairos-init older than that Hadron cannot regenerate its initramfs (dracut -f fails). Keep both images -- all four Dockerfile ARG and Makefile default lines -- in one PR so the pair is reviewed as a single decision. separateMajorMinor=false holds them together even though their version lines now differ: Hadron still ships v0.x, while kairos-init moved to the kairos monorepo's v4.x after kairos-io/kairos-init was archived. dependencyDashboardApproval is set because Renovate structurally CANNOT compute the right target here: the correct pin is whatever Kairos release X resolves to, not the newest tag of either image. Hadron auto-releases twice a week (kairos-io/hadron#832) and therefore runs chronically ahead of the Kairos-validated pairing -- Kairos v4.5.2, v4.5.0 and v4.4.0 all build on Hadron v0.6.3, and no Kairos release has ever used v0.6.4 or v0.6.5. An auto-opened PR would be either noise or a trap that looks routine, so a base move must start as a deliberate click on the dependency dashboard.
prBodyNotes: DO NOT take the newest tag of either image. Both pins are derived from ONE Kairos release.

Resolve the Hadron version for the Kairos release you intend to ship (the tag prefix is the Hadron version): curl -fsSL "https://quay.io/api/v1/repository/kairos/hadron/tag/?onlyActiveTags=true&limit=100&filter_tag_name=like:core-amd64-generic-<kairos-tag>" -- this is the same lookup kairos-io/kairos does in .github/public-cloud/resolve-hadron-container-image.sh.
KAIROS_INIT_IMAGE is that same Kairos release tag (kairos-init ships from the kairos monorepo and shares its version; kairos-io/kairos-init is archived, so never follow its 0.x line).
Re-resolve both digests with docker buildx imagetools inspect and update the Dockerfile ARG and the Makefile default together, or make verify-pins fails.
Container e2e cannot boot the result: a base move still wants a VM boot test.
